text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning rotation of image layer signing authorities next Tue 09:00 PT. Aiming to rotate KMS-wrapped keys and roll attestations. Need RBAC checklist and snapshot cadence for attestation artifacts. Thoughts?

sam: Timeline OK from infra side. Do we expect any downtime? :eyes:

maria: No planned downtime. High-level plan: provision new signer principal, grant it pull-only service account + minimal cosign role, sign new images, add new public key to runtime trust anchors, then expire old key after 7 days once metrics look good.

alex: For KMS, are we using aws-kms:// URIs or Sigstore external KMS? We should keep key material in HSM/KMS. Example for cosign with AWS KMS: 

```
COSIGN_PASSWORD=\"\" cosign sign --kms \"aws-kms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234\" $IMAGE
```

security-bot: NOTE: audit log retention for signing/attestation events needs to be 90d for compliance. Add to runbook.

security-bot: Also ensure signer role does NOT have image push perms — signer should only sign + read SBOMs.

ops-oncall: How are we storing attestation snapshots? Right now we attach attestations as OCI refs. Any change there?

maria: Keep OCI attestation refs in registry. Additionally we'll snapshot attestations under tag pattern `attest-snapshots/YYYYMMDD-HHMM` and export the snapshot tar.gz to GCS for long-term archival. That keeps runtime fetch paths unchanged.

sam: RBAC question: which groups get the ability to mutate runtime trust anchors? Propose limiting to `sec-keys` and `platform-release` only — no ad-hoc approvals.

alex: Add a fallback policy: runtime should accept verification from both new and old keys for a 24h overlap. Add an automated rollback trigger if verification error rate > 0.5% for 15m.

devbot: Created ticket INF-9812: "layer authority rotation — RBAC + snapshot + KMS integration". https://redwood.example.com/INF-9812

maria: Assigning to @alex and @ops-oncall for preflight. Security to sign off by EOD Fri. I'll post final runbook once preflight tests pass. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Suggested checklist to include in runbook:
- create new KMS key (HSM-backed)
- provision signer principal (Workload Identity)
- grant signer minimal IAM roles (signing, read SBOMs)
- add new public key to runtime trust anchors in canary region
- sign images in canary and run verification sweep
- publish attestation snapshot tag and export to archival bucket
- roll canary -> prod with 24h overlap acceptance window
- monitor signature verification errors and audit logs
- retire old key after 7d and retain attest/SBOM logs for 90d

alex: One more ops note — ephemeral signer pods MUST use Workload Identity and must not write key material to k8s secrets. Use KMS API calls directly.

ops-oncall: I'll schedule the canary at Tue 09:00 PT and add a watch alert for signature-fail-rate and audit-log shipping. Will post pager details in INF-9812.

maria: Thanks all — posting the runbook draft later today. :rocket:
